341: Jhajha: you are entangled in the world, and you do not know how to get untangled.
You hold back in fear, and you are not approved by the Lord.
Why do you talk such nonsense, trying to convince others?
Stirring up arguments, you shall obtain only arguments. ॥15॥
ਞੰਞਾ ਨਿਕਟਿ. ਜੁ ਘਟ ਰਹਿਓ; ਦੂਰਿ; ਕਹਾ ਤਜਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
Nyanya: He dwells near you, deep within your heart; why do you leave Him and go far away?
ਜਾ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਜਗੁ ਢੂਢਿਅਉ; ਨੇਰਉ ਪਾਇਅਉ ਤਾਹਿ ॥੧੬॥
I searched the whole world for Him, but I found Him near me. ॥16॥
Tainka: the treacherous crossing to the Lord is within your own heart.
ਖੋਲਿ ਕਪਾਟ; ਮਹਲਿ ਕਿ ਨ ਜਾਹੀ ॥
Open the doors, and enter the mansion of His presence.
ਦੇਖਿ ਅਟਲ; ਟਲਿ. ਕਤਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਵਾ ॥
Beholding the unmoving Lord, you shall not slip away and go anywhere else.
You shall remain firmly attached to God, and your heart shall be happy. ॥17॥
Thaththa: keep yourself far away from the mirage of Maya.
With great difficulty, I have calmed my mind.
ਜਿਨਿ ਠਗਿ ਠਗਿਆ; ਸਗਲ ਜਗੁ ਖਾਵਾ ॥
That cheat who cheated and devoured the whole world —
ਸੋ ਠਗੁ ਠਗਿਆ; ਠਉਰ ਮਨੁ ਆਵਾ ॥੧੮॥
I have cheated that cheat, and my mind is now at peace. ॥18॥
Dadda: when the fear of God wells up, other fears depart.
ਤਾ ਡਰ ਮਹਿ; ਡਰੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
Other fears are absorbed into that fear.
ਜਉ ਡਰ ਡਰੈ; ਤ ਫਿਰਿ ਡਰੁ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
When one rejects the fear of God, other fears cling to him.
ਨਿਡਰ ਹੂਆ; ਡਰੁ ਉਰ ਹੋਇ ਭਾਗੈ ॥੧੯॥
But if he becomes fearless, the fears of his heart run away. ॥19॥
Dhadda: why do you search in other directions?
Searching for Him like this, the breath of life runs out.
When one returns, after climbing the mountain and searching there,
ਜਿਹ ਗੜੁ ਗੜਿਓ; ਸੁ ਗੜ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਵਾ ॥੨੦॥
he finds Him in the fortress of the body which He Himself made. ॥20॥
ਣਾਣਾ. ਰਣਿ ਰੂਤਉ; ਨਰ ਨੇਹੀ ਕਰੈ ॥
Naana: the warrior who fights on the battlefield should keep up and press on.
He should not yield, and he should not retreat.
Blessed is the coming of the one
who conquers the one mind and renounces the many. ॥21॥
Tatta: the impassable world-ocean cannot be crossed;
the body's senses remain entangled in the three worlds.
But when the three worlds are absorbed within the body,
ਤਉ. ਤਤਹਿ ਤਤ ਮਿਲਿਆ; ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵਾ ॥੨੨॥
then one's essence merges with the Essence, and the True Lord is obtained. ॥22॥
Thatha: He is unfathomable; His depths cannot be fathomed.
ਓਹੁ ਅਥਾਹ; ਇਹੁ ਥਿਰੁ. ਨ ਰਹਾਵਾ ॥
He is unfathomable, and this mind does not remain steady.
On a tiny plot of land, one begins to build many places,
as though building a mansion without pillars. ॥23॥
Dada: whatever is seen shall perish.
Contemplate the One who is unseen.
When the key is inserted in the tenth gate,
then the vision of the Merciful Lord is seen. ॥24॥
Dhadha: when one ascends from the lower realms to the higher realms, then everything is resolved.
The Lord dwells in both the lower and the higher worlds.
Leaving the lower world, the soul ascends to the higher world;
ਤਉ ਅਰਧਹਿ ਉਰਧ ਮਿਲਿਆ; ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਾ ॥੨੫॥
then the lower and the higher join together, and peace is obtained. ॥25॥
Nanna: one's days and nights pass looking for the Lord;
looking for Him in this way, one's eyes become bloodshot.
After looking and looking, when one finally finds Him,
then the One who was looking for Him meets the One who was looked for. ॥26॥
Pappa: He is limitless; His limits cannot be found.
I have attuned myself to the Supreme Light.
One who restrains his five senses
rises above both sin and virtue. ॥27॥
Phaphpha: even without the flower, the fruit is produced.
ਤਾ ਫਲ ਫੰਕ; ਲਖੈ ਜਉ ਕੋਈ ॥
One who looks at a slice of that fruit
and reflects on it does not go to reincarnation.
ਤਾ ਫਲ ਫੰਕ; ਸਭੈ ਤਨ ਫਾਰੈ ॥੨੮॥
A slice of that fruit slices away all bodily attachment. ॥28॥
Babba: when one drop blends with another drop,
these drops cannot be separated again.
Becoming the Lord's slave, hold tight to His meditation.
342: Becoming His minstrel, one comes to understand the bonds. ॥29॥
Bhabha: when doubt is pierced, union is achieved.
I have shattered my fear, and now I have faith.
I thought that He was outside of me, but now I know that He is within me.
When I came to understand this mystery, I recognised the Lord of the world. ॥30॥
Mamma: clinging to the source, the mind is satisfied.
ਮਰਮੀ ਹੋਇ; ਸੁ. ਮਨ ਕਉ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
One who knows this mystery understands his own mind.
Let no one delay in uniting his mind.
ਮਗਨ ਭਇਆ ਤੇ; ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੩੧॥
Those who are absorbed in Him obtain the True Lord. ॥31॥
ਮਮਾ. ਮਨ ਸਿਉ ਕਾਜੁ ਹੈ; ਮਨ ਸਾਧੇ. ਸਿਧਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
Mamma: the mortal's business is with his own mind; one who disciplines the mind attains perfection.
ਮਨ ਹੀ ਮਨ ਸਿਉ, ਕਹੈ ਕਬੀਰਾ; ਮਨ ਸਾ. ਮਿਲਿਆ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੩੨॥
Only the mind can deal with the mind, says Kabeer; I have not met anything like the mind. ॥32॥
ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਕਤੀ; ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਉ ॥
This mind becomes Maya; this mind becomes the Lord.
ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ; ਪੰਚ ਤਤ ਕੋ ਜੀਉ ॥
This mind becomes the body of the five elements.
ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਲੇ; ਜਉ ਉਨਮਨਿ ਰਹੈ ॥
When one takes hold of this mind and remains in the state of rapture,
ਤਉ; ਤੀਨਿ ਲੋਕ ਕੀ ਬਾਤੈ ਕਹੈ ॥੩੩॥
then one speaks of the Lord of the three worlds. ॥33॥
ਯਯਾ. ਜਉ ਜਾਨਹਿ, ਤਉ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਨਿ; ਕਰਿ ਬਸਿ ਕਾਇਆ ਗਾਉ ॥
Yayya: if you wish to know the way, then destroy your evil-mindedness, and subdue the village of the body.
ਰਣਿ ਰੂਤਉ. ਭਾਜੈ ਨਹੀ; ਸੂਰਉ. ਥਾਰਉ ਨਾਉ ॥੩੪॥
If you do not run away when engaged in this battle, then you are worthy to be called a hero. ॥34॥
Rara: one who knows worldly tastes to be tasteless
becomes free of them, and recognises that true taste.
ਇਹ ਰਸ ਛਾਡੇ; ਉਹ ਰਸੁ ਆਵਾ ॥
Renouncing these tastes, that taste is obtained.
ਉਹ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਆ; ਇਹ ਰਸੁ ਨਹੀ ਭਾਵਾ ॥੩੫॥
One who drinks in that taste is no longer pleased by these tastes. ॥35॥
Lalla: one who attunes the mind with such love
ਅਨਤ ਨ ਜਾਇ; ਪਰਮ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
does not go elsewhere, and obtains the supreme Truth.
ਅਰੁ ਜਉ ਤਹਾ; ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
And if, there, one is filled with love and affection,
ਤਉ ਅਲਹ ਲਹੈ; ਲਹਿ ਚਰਨ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੩੬॥
then one obtains the Lord, and having obtained Him, one is absorbed into His feet. ॥36॥
Vava: time and again, dwell upon the Lord.
Dwelling upon the Lord, defeat shall not come to you.
ਬਲਿ; ਬਲਿ; ਜੇ ਬਿਸਨਤਨਾ, ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to those who sing the praises of the Lord,
ਵਿਸਨ ਮਿਲੇ; ਸਭ ਹੀ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੩੭॥
meeting the Lord, they find the True One everywhere. ॥37॥
ਵਾਵਾ. ਵਾਹੀ ਜਾਨੀਐ; ਵਾ ਜਾਨੇ ਇਹੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Vava: know Him alone; knowing Him, one becomes Him.
ਇਹੁ ਅਰੁ ਓਹੁ. ਜਬ ਮਿਲੈ; ਤਬ ਮਿਲਤ. ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੩੮॥
When this soul and that Lord are blended, then, being blended, they cannot be told apart. ॥38॥
Sassa: discipline your mind with excellence.
Refrain from that talk which does not draw the heart to God.
When the heart is drawn to God and love wells up,
then the King of the three worlds is seen pervading there. ॥39॥
Khakha: if someone takes up the search for Him,
ਜੋ ਖੋਜੈ; ਸੋ. ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
then, having found Him, he is not born again.
When someone searches, understands and contemplates Him,
ਤਉ ਭਵਜਲ ਤਰਤ; ਨ ਲਾਵੈ ਬਾਰਾ ॥੪੦॥
then he crosses over the terrifying world-ocean in an instant. ॥40॥
Sassa: she who adorns the bed of her Husband Lord —
ਅਲਪ ਸੁਖ ਛਾਡਿ; ਪਰਮ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਾ ॥
Renouncing the shallow pleasures, she obtains the supreme bliss;
ਤਬ ਇਹ ਤ੍ਰੀਅ; ਓੁਹੁ. ਕੰਤੁ ਕਹਾਵਾ ॥੪੧॥
then she is truly the bride, and He is called her Husband. ॥41॥
Haha: He exists, but one does not know that He exists.
ਜਬ ਹੀ ਹੋਇ; ਤਬਹਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਾ ॥
When one comes to know that He exists, then the mind is pleased and appeased.
ਹੈ ਤਉ ਸਹੀ; ਲਖੈ ਜਉ ਕੋਈ ॥
Of course the Lord exists, if only one could understand Him.
ਤਬ ਓਹੀ ਉਹੁ; ਏਹੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੪੨॥
Then He alone exists, and this mortal does not exist as separate. ॥42॥
ਲਿੰਉ ਲਿੰਉ ਕਰਤ; ਫਿਰੈ ਸਭੁ ਲੋਗੁ ॥
Everyone goes around saying, "Let me gather, let me gather."
Because of this, they suffer great sorrow.
ਲਖਿਮੀ ਬਰ ਸਿਉ; ਜਉ ਲਿਉ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
But when one comes to love the Lord, the Husband of the goddess of wealth,
ਸੋਗੁ ਮਿਟੈ; ਸਭ ਹੀ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੪੩॥
sorrow departs, and one obtains total peace. ॥43॥
Khakha: so many have wasted away and been destroyed!
Wasting away and being destroyed, they still do not remember the Lord.
ਅਬ ਜਗੁ ਜਾਨਿ; ਜਉ ਮਨਾ ਰਹੈ ॥
But if one comes to know the reality of the world now, and keeps the mind steady,
ਜਹ ਕਾ ਬਿਛੁਰਾ; ਤਹ ਥਿਰੁ ਲਹੈ ॥੪੪॥
he shall find his permanent home in the One from whom he was separated. ॥44॥
343: The fifty-two letters have been joined together,
but people cannot recognise the One Imperishable Word of God.
Kabeer speaks the Word of Truth.
One who is a true Pandit remains in a state of spiritual awareness.
It is the business of the Pandits to join the letters together;
the spiritually wise contemplate the essence of reality.
ਜਾ ਕੈ ਜੀਅ; ਜੈਸੀ ਬੁਧਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
According to the wisdom within one's mind,
says Kabeer, so does one come to understand. ॥45॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਥਿਤੀੰ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ਕੀੰ ॥
There are fifteen lunar days, and seven days of the week.
Says Kabeer, I sing of Him who has no near or far shore.
When the seekers come to know His mystery,
they see the Creator Himself as the Divine Light everywhere. ॥1॥
The night of the new moon: give up your hopes.
Remember the Lord, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.
You shall find the gate of liberation while yet alive.
You shall come to know the Word of the Fearless Lord, and the essence of your own innermost being. ॥1॥
One who is in love with the lotus feet of the Lord of the universe —
ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ. ਭਏ ਮਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ; ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
by the grace of the saints, his mind becomes pure; night and day, he remains awake in the Lord's praise. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The first day of the lunar cycle: contemplate the Beloved Lord.
He is playing within the heart, yet He has no body, and He is infinite.
The pain of death never consumes that person
who remains absorbed in the Primal Lord God. ॥2॥
The second day: understand that there are two beings in the fibre of the body:
Maya and God are blended with everything.
ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਬਢੈ; ਨ ਘਟਤਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
God does not increase or decrease.
He is without ancestry, immaculate, always the same. ॥3॥
The third day: one who keeps the three qualities in equilibrium
finds the source of ecstasy and the highest status.
In the company of the holy, faith wells up:
outside, and deep within, God's light is always shining. ॥4॥
The fourth day: restrain your fickle mind,
ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਸੰਗਿ; ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਬਹਹੁ ॥
and never associate with sexual desire or anger.
On land and sea, He Himself is in Himself.
He Himself meditates and chants His own meditation. ॥5॥
The fifth day: the world is an expansion of the five elements.
People are occupied in the pursuits of gold and women.
How rare are those who drink in the pure essence of the Lord's love!
ਜਰਾ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ; ਫੇਰਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੬॥
They shall never again suffer the pains of old age and death. ॥6॥
ਛਠਿ; ਖਟੁ ਚਕ੍ਰ, ਛਹੂੰ ਦਿਸ ਧਾਇ ॥
The sixth day: the five senses and the mind run off in all six directions.
Without the enlightenment of God, they do not hold still.
Erase your duality and hold tight to patience,
ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਕੀ; ਸੂਲ ਨ ਸਹਹੁ ॥੭॥
and you shall not have to endure the torture of rituals and religious ceremonies. ॥7॥
The seventh day: know the Word as true,
and the Lord, the Supreme Soul, shall accept you.
Your doubts shall be eradicated, and your pains eliminated,
and in the ocean of the celestial void, you shall find peace. ॥8॥
The eighth day: the body is made of the eight ingredients.
ਤਾ ਮਹਿ; ਅਕੁਲ ਮਹਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
Within it is the Unknowable Lord, the King of the supreme treasure.
The Guru, who knows this spiritual wisdom, reveals the secret of this mystery.
Turning away from the world, one dwells upon the unbreakable and impenetrable Lord. ॥9॥
The ninth day: keep the nine gates of the body disciplined.
Forget all your greed and emotional attachment;
344: ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੀਵਹੁ; ਅਮਰ ਫਲ ਖਾਹੁ ॥੧੦॥
you shall live throughout the ages, eating the fruit of immortality. ॥10॥
The tenth day: there is ecstasy in all directions.
Doubt is dispelled, and the Lord of the universe is met.
He is the embodiment of light, the incomparable essence.
ਅਮਲ. ਨ ਮਲ ਨ; ਛਾਹ ਨਹੀ ਧੂਪ ॥੧੧॥
He is stainless, without stain, beyond both shade and sunshine. ॥11॥
The eleventh day: if you run in the direction of the One,
ਤਉ ਜੋਨੀ ਸੰਕਟ; ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
you shall not suffer the pains of reincarnation again.
Your body shall become cool, immaculate and pure.
The Lord was said to be far away, but He is found near at hand. ॥12॥
The twelfth day: twelve suns rise within.
Day and night, the celestial bugles vibrate the unstruck melody.
Then, one beholds the Father of the three worlds.
This is wonderful! The human being has become God! ॥13॥
The thirteenth day: speak the praises of the Inaccessible Lord,
and recognise Him as the same in the lower worlds and the higher.
There is no high or low, no honour or dishonour.
The Lord is all-pervading, alike in all. ॥14॥
The fourteenth day: in the fourteen worlds,
and on each and every hair, the Lord abides.
Fix your meditation on truth and contentment.
Speak the speech of God's spiritual wisdom. ॥15॥
The day of the full moon: the full moon fills the heavens.
Its power is spread through its light, the light of poise.
ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਮਧਿ; ਹੋਇ ਰਹਿਆ ਥੀਰ ॥
In the beginning, in the end and in the middle, God remains firm and steady.
Kabeer is immersed in the ocean of peace. ॥16॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਵਾਰ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ ੭ ॥
ਬਾਰ ਬਾਰ; ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਉ ॥
Again and again, I sing the glorious praises of the Lord.
ਗੁਰ ਗਮਿ ਭੇਦੁ; ਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਪਾਵਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Through the Guru, I obtain the secret of the Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Sunday: begin the devotional worship of the Lord,
and restrain the desires within the temple of the body.
When your attention is fixed day and night upon that imperishable place,
ਤਉ ਅਨਹਦ ਬੇਣੁ; ਸਹਜ ਮਹਿ ਬਾਇ ॥੧॥
then the celestial flutes play the unstruck melody in tranquil peace and poise. ॥1॥
Monday: the ambrosial nectar trickles down from the moon.
Tasting it, all poisons are removed in an instant.
Restrained by the Guru's Bani, the mind remains indoors;
drinking in this nectar, it is intoxicated. ॥2॥
Tuesday: build a fortress of the Lord's praise around you,
and understand the ways of the five thieves.
Do not leave your own home to go wandering outside,
or else your mind shall become terribly troubled. ॥3॥
ਹਿਰਦੈ ਕਮਲ ਮਹਿ; ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਬਾਸ ॥
and the Lord comes to dwell in the lotus of the heart.
ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ; ਦੋਊ ਏਕ ਸਮ ਧਰੈ ॥
Meeting the Guru, one comes to look upon the soul and God alike,
and the inverted lotus of the heart is turned upright. ॥4॥
Forsake the trinity of the three qualities, and attach yourself to the One Lord.
Those who remain caught in the three rivers of the three qualities, held in conflict,
do not wash away their sins, day or night. ॥5॥
ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਹਾਰੈ; ਸੁ ਇਹ ਬ੍ਰਤਿ ਚੜੈ ॥
Friday: one who makes good deeds his support keeps up this fast,
struggling against his own self, day and night.
If you restrain your five senses,
ਤਉ ਦੂਜੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ; ਨ ਪੈਸੈ ਕਬੈ ॥੬॥
then you shall never again cast your gaze on duality. ॥6॥
ਜੋਤਿ ਦੀ ਵਟੀ; ਘਟ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਇ ॥
the light of God's candle within your heart;
you shall be enlightened, inwardly and outwardly.
ਤਬ ਹੂਆ; ਸਗਲ ਕਰਮ ਕਾ ਨਾਸੁ ॥੭॥
Then all the bonds of past deeds are destroyed. ॥7॥
345: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਘਟ ਮਹਿ; ਦੂਜੀ ਆਨ ॥
As long as there is any thought of other things within the heart,
ਤਉ ਲਉ; ਮਹਲਿ. ਨ ਲਾਭੈ ਜਾਨ ॥
one cannot enter the mansion of the Lord's presence.
Dwelling upon the Lord, one comes to love Him;
says Kabeer, then one's being becomes pure. ॥8॥1॥
ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਚੇਤੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
O Lord, You made even the stones float.
ਰਾਮ ਕਹਤ; ਜਨ ਕਸ ਨ ਤਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
So why should Your humble servants, who chant Your Name, not float across as well? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਤਾਰੀਲੇ ਗਨਿਕਾ, ਬਿਨੁ ਰੂਪ ਕੁਬਿਜਾ; ਬਿਆਧਿ ਅਜਾਮਲੁ ਤਾਰੀਅਲੇ ॥
You saved the prostitute, and the ugly hunchback; You saved Ajaamal, sunk in vice.
ਚਰਨ ਬਧਿਕ; ਜਨ ਤੇਊ. ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭਏ ॥
The hunter who shot Krishna in the foot — even he was liberated.
ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ; ਜਿਨ ਰਾਮ ਕਹੇ ॥੧॥
I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to those who chant the Lord's Name. ॥1॥
ਦਾਸੀ ਸੁਤ ਜਨੁ ਬਿਦਰੁ. ਸੁਦਾਮਾ; ਉਗ੍ਰਸੈਨ ਕਉ ਰਾਜ ਦੀਏ ॥
You saved Bidur, the son of the slave-girl, and Sudaamaa; You restored Ugrasain to his throne.
ਜਪ ਹੀਨ. ਤਪ ਹੀਨ. ਕੁਲ ਹੀਨ. ਕ੍ਰਮ ਹੀਨ; ਨਾਮੇ ਕੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੇਊ ਤਰੇ ॥੨॥੧॥
Without meditation, without penance, without a good family, without good deeds — even they were saved by Naam Dayv's Lord and Master. ॥2॥1॥
ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਕੇ ਪਦੇ ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ॥
ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
One Creator, whose Name is Truth, the Maker — realised by the Guru's grace
ਮੇਰੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪੋਚ; ਸੋਚ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
My company is low, and I worry about it day and night;
my actions are crooked, and I am of lowly birth. ॥1॥
O Lord, Master of the earth, Life of my soul,
ਮੋਹਿ. ਨ ਬਿਸਾਰਹੁ; ਮੈ ਜਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
please do not forget me! I am Your humble servant. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਮੇਰੀ ਹਰਹੁ ਬਿਪਤਿ; ਜਨ ਕਰਹੁ ਸੁਭਾਈ ॥
Take away my afflictions, and bless Your humble servant with a good disposition.
ਚਰਣ ਨ ਛਾਡਉ; ਸਰੀਰ ਕਲ ਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
I shall not leave Your feet, even if my body's strength fails. ॥2॥
Says Ravi Daas, I seek the protection of Your sanctuary;
ਬੇਗਿ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਜਨ; ਕਰਿ ਨ ਬਿਲਾਂਬਾ ॥੩॥੧॥
please meet Your humble servant quickly; do not delay! ॥3॥1॥
Baygumpura, "the city without sorrow," is the name of the town.
There is no suffering or anxiety there.
There are no troubles or taxes on commodities there.
ਖਉਫੁ ਨ ਖਤਾ; ਨ ਤਰਸੁ ਜਵਾਲੁ ॥੧॥
There is no fear, blemish or downfall there. ॥1॥
ਅਬ ਮੋਹਿ; ਖੂਬ ਵਤਨ ਗਹ ਪਾਈ ॥
Now, I have found this most excellent city.
ਊਹਾਂ ਖੈਰਿ ਸਦਾ; ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
There is lasting peace and safety there, O my brother. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
God's kingdom is steady, stable and eternal.
ਦੋਮ ਨ ਸੇਮ; ਏਕ ਸੋ ਆਹੀ ॥
There is no second or third status; all are equal there.
That city is populous and eternally famous.
Those who live there are wealthy and contented. ॥2॥
ਤਿਉ ਤਿਉ ਸੈਲ ਕਰਹਿ; ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
They stroll about freely, just as they please.
They know the mansion of the Lord's presence, and no one blocks their way.
Says Ravi Daas, the emancipated shoemaker:
ਜੋ ਹਮ ਸਹਰੀ; ਸੁ ਮੀਤੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥੩॥੨॥
whoever is a citizen there is a friend of mine. ॥3॥2॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਘਟ ਅਵਘਟ ਡੂਗਰ ਘਣਾ; ਇਕੁ ਨਿਰਗੁਣੁ ਬੈਲੁ ਹਮਾਰ ॥
The road to my Lord is treacherous and mountainous, and all I have is this worthless ox.
ਰਮਈਏ ਸਿਉ ਇਕ ਬੇਨਤੀ; ਮੇਰੀ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਰਾਖੁ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
I offer this one prayer to the Lord, to preserve my capital. ॥1॥
ਕੋ ਬਨਜਾਰੋ ਰਾਮ ਕੋ; ਮੇਰਾ ਟਾਂਡਾ ਲਾਦਿਆ ਜਾਇ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Is there any merchant of the Lord to join me? My cargo is loaded and now I am leaving. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
346: ਹਉ ਬਨਜਾਰੋ. ਰਾਮ ਕੋ; ਸਹਜ ਕਰਉ ਬੵਾਪਾਰੁ ॥
I am the merchant of the Lord; I deal in spiritual wisdom and poise.
ਮੈ. ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਲਾਦਿਆ; ਬਿਖੁ ਲਾਦੀ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
I have loaded the wealth of the Lord's Name; the world has loaded poison. ॥2॥
ਉਰਵਾਰ ਪਾਰ ਕੇ ਦਾਨੀਆ; ਲਿਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਆਲ ਪਤਾਲੁ ॥
O you who know this world and the world beyond: write whatever nonsense you like about me.
ਮੋਹਿ ਜਮ ਡੰਡੁ. ਨ ਲਾਗਈ; ਤਜੀਲੇ ਸਰਬ ਜੰਜਾਲ ॥੩॥
The club of the messenger of death shall not strike me, since I have cast off all entanglements. ॥3॥
ਜੈਸਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਸੁੰਭ ਕਾ; ਤੈਸਾ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
Love of this world is like the pale, temporary colour of the safflower.
ਮੇਰੇ ਰਮਈਏ. ਰੰਗੁ ਮਜੀਠ ਕਾ; ਕਹੁ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਚਮਾਰ ॥੪॥੧॥
The colour of my Lord's love, however, is permanent, like the dye of the madder plant; says Ravi Daas, the shoemaker. ॥4॥1॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਕੂਪੁ ਭਰਿਓ ਜੈਸੇ ਦਾਦਿਰਾ; ਕਛੁ ਦੇਸੁ ਬਿਦੇਸੁ. ਨ ਬੂਝ ॥
The frogs in a deep well know nothing of their own country or other lands;
ਐਸੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਬਿਮੋਹਿਆ; ਕਛੁ ਆਰਾ ਪਾਰੁ. ਨ ਸੂਝ ॥੧॥
just so, my mind, infatuated with corruption, understands nothing of this world or the next. ॥1॥
ਸਗਲ ਭਵਨ ਕੇ ਨਾਇਕਾ; ਇਕੁ ਛਿਨੁ ਦਰਸੁ ਦਿਖਾਇ ਜੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O Lord of all worlds, reveal to me, even for an instant, the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਮਲਿਨ ਭਈ ਮਤਿ. ਮਾਧਵਾ; ਤੇਰੀ ਗਤਿ. ਲਖੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
My intellect is polluted; I cannot understand Your state, O Lord.
ਕਰਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ. ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਚੂਕਈ; ਮੈ ਸੁਮਤਿ ਦੇਹੁ ਸਮਝਾਇ ॥੨॥
Have pity on me, dispel my doubts, and teach me true wisdom. ॥2॥
ਜੋਗੀਸਰ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਨਹੀ; ਤੁਅ ਗੁਣ ਕਥਨੁ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
Even the great Yogis cannot describe Your glorious virtues; they are beyond words.
ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਕੈ ਕਾਰਣੈ; ਕਹੁ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਚਮਾਰ ॥੩॥੧॥
I am dedicated to Your loving devotional worship, says Ravi Daas the shoemaker. ॥3॥1॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਸਤਜੁਗਿ ਸਤੁ. ਤੇਤਾ ਜਗੀ; ਦੁਆਪਰਿ ਪੂਜਾਚਾਰ ॥
In the Golden Age of Sat Yuga, there was truth; in the Silver Age of Traytaa Yuga, charitable feasts; in the Brass Age of Dwaapar Yuga, there was worship.
ਤੀਨੌ ਜੁਗ ਤੀਨੌ ਦਿੜੇ; ਕਲਿ ਕੇਵਲ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰ ॥੧॥
In those three ages, people held to these three ways. But in the Iron Age of Kali Yuga, the Name is your only support. ॥1॥
ਮੋ ਸਉ; ਕੋਊ. ਨ ਕਹੈ ਸਮਝਾਇ ॥
No one has explained to me
ਜਾ ਤੇ; ਆਵਾ ਗਵਨੁ ਬਿਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
how I can escape reincarnation. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਧਰਮ ਨਿਰੂਪੀਐ; ਕਰਤਾ ਦੀਸੈ ਸਭ ਲੋਇ ॥
So many forms of religion have been described; the whole world is practising them.
ਕਵਨ ਕਰਮ ਤੇ ਛੂਟੀਐ; ਜਿਹ ਸਾਧੇ ਸਭ ਸਿਧਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
What actions will bring emancipation, and complete spiritual perfection? ॥2॥
ਕਰਮ ਅਕਰਮ ਬੀਚਾਰੀਐ; ਸੰਕਾ ਸੁਨਿ ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ॥
One may distinguish between good and evil actions, and listen to the Vedas and Puranas,
ਸੰਸਾ ਸਦ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਬਸੈ; ਕਉਨੁ ਹਿਰੈ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥੩॥
but doubt still dwells in the heart; who can eradicate egotistical pride? ॥3॥
ਬਾਹਰੁ ਉਦਕਿ ਪਖਾਰੀਐ; ਘਟ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਬਿਬਿਧਿ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
Outwardly, he washes with water, but deep within, his heart is tarnished by all sorts of vices.
ਸੁਧ ਕਵਨ ਪਰ ਹੋਇਬੋ; ਸੁਚ ਕੁੰਚਰ ਬਿਧਿ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ॥੪॥
So how can he become pure? His method of purification is like that of an elephant, covering himself with dust right after his bath! ॥4॥
ਰਵਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ. ਰਜਨੀ ਜਥਾ ਗਤਿ; ਜਾਨਤ ਸਭ ਸੰਸਾਰ ॥
With the rising of the sun, the night comes to its end; the whole world knows this.
ਪਾਰਸ ਮਾਨੋ ਤਾਬੋ ਛੁਏ; ਕਨਕ ਹੋਤ. ਨਹੀ ਬਾਰ ॥੫॥
It is believed that with the touch of the philosopher's stone, copper is immediately transformed into gold. ॥5॥
ਪਰਮ ਪਰਸ ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੀਐ; ਪੂਰਬ ਲਿਖਤ ਲਿਲਾਟ ॥
When one meets the Guru, the supreme philosopher's stone, if such pre-ordained destiny is written on one's forehead,
ਉਨਮਨ. ਮਨ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਮਿਲੇ; ਛੁਟਕਤ ਬਜਰ ਕਪਾਟ ॥੬॥
the soul blends with the Supreme Soul, and the stubborn doors are opened wide. ॥6॥
ਭਗਤਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ. ਮਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਕਰੀ; ਭ੍ਰਮ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਿ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
Through the way of devotion, the intellect is imbued with Truth; doubts, entanglements and vices are cut away.
ਸੋਈ ਬਸਿ ਰਸਿ. ਮਨ ਮਿਲੇ; ਗੁਨ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਏਕ ਬਿਚਾਰ ॥੭॥
The mind is restrained, and one obtains bliss, contemplating the One God, who is both with and without qualities. ॥7॥
ਅਨਿਕ ਜਤਨ ਨਿਗ੍ਰਹ ਕੀਏ; ਟਾਰੀ ਨ ਟਰੈ. ਭ੍ਰਮ ਫਾਸ ॥
I have tried many methods of restraint, but by turning it away, the noose of doubt is not turned away.
ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ. ਨਹੀ ਊਪਜੈ; ਤਾ ਤੇ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਉਦਾਸ ॥੮॥੧॥
Loving devotion has not welled up within me, and so Ravi Daas is sad and depressed. ॥8॥1॥
347: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
One Creator, whose Name is Truth: the Maker, all-pervading, without fear, without enmity, beyond time, unborn, self-existent — realised by the Guru's grace.
ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧; ਘਰੁ ੧ ਸੋ ਦਰੁ ॥
ਸੋ ਦਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੇਹਾ. ਸੋ ਘਰੁ ਕੇਹਾ; ਜਿਤੁ ਬਹਿ ਸਰਬ ਸਮੑਾਲੇ ॥
Where is that Gate, and where is that Dwelling, in which You sit and take care of all?
ਵਾਜੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਦ ਅਨੇਕ ਅਸੰਖਾ; ਕੇਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਵਾਵਣਹਾਰੇ ॥
The Sound-current of the Naad vibrates there for You, and countless musicians play all sorts of instruments there for You.
ਕੇਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਰਾਗ ਪਰੀ ਸਿਉ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ; ਕੇਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਗਾਵਣਹਾਰੇ ॥
There are so many Ragas, so many musical harmonies to You; so many minstrels sing hymns of You.
ਗਾਵਨੑਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ. ਪਉਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ; ਗਾਵੈ ਰਾਜਾ ਧਰਮ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥
Wind, water and fire sing of You; the Righteous Judge of Dharma sings at Your Door.
ਗਾਵਨੑਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ. ਚਿਤੁ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਲਿਖਿ ਜਾਣਨਿ; ਲਿਖਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਧਰਮੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
Chitr and Gupt, the angels of the conscious and the subconscious who know how to write, sing of You; they write the record which the Righteous Judge of Dharma reads and judges.
ਗਾਵਨੑਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ. ਈਸਰੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਦੇਵੀ; ਸੋਹਨਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
Shiva, Brahma and the Goddess of Beauty, ever adorned by You, sing of You.
ਗਾਵਨੑਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ. ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਇੰਦ੍ਰਾਸਣਿ ਬੈਠੇ; ਦੇਵਤਿਆ ਦਰਿ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
Indra, seated on his throne, sings of You, with the deities at Your Door.
ਗਾਵਨੑਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ. ਸਿਧ ਸਮਾਧੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ; ਗਾਵਨੑਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ. ਸਾਧ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
The Siddhas in Samaadhi sing of You; the holy sing of You in contemplation.
ਗਾਵਨੑਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ. ਜਤੀ ਸਤੀ ਸੰਤੋਖੀ; ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ. ਵੀਰ ਕਰਾਰੇ ॥
The celibates, the givers of charity and the contented sing of You; the fearless warriors sing of You.
ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ. ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪੜੇ ਰਖੀਸੁਰ; ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਬੇਦਾ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
The Pandits, the religious scholars who recite the Vedas, with the supreme sages of all the ages, sing of You.
ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ. ਮੋਹਣੀਆ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਨਿ; ਸੁਰਗੁ ਮਛੁ ਪਇਆਲੇ ॥
The enchanting heavenly beauties who entice hearts in this world, in paradise and in the underworld below, sing of You.
ਗਾਵਨੑਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ. ਰਤਨ ਉਪਾਏ ਤੇਰੇ ਜੇਤੇ; ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
The fourteen priceless jewels created by You, and the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage, sing of You.
ਗਾਵਨੑਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ. ਜੋਧ ਮਹਾਬਲ ਸੂਰਾ; ਗਾਵਨੑਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ. ਖਾਣੀ ਚਾਰੇ ॥
The mighty warriors and divine heroes sing of You; the four sources of creation sing of You.
ਗਾਵਨੑਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ. ਖੰਡ ਮੰਡਲ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡਾ; ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਰਖੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
The worlds, solar systems and galaxies, created and arranged by Your Hand, sing of You.
ਸੇਈ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਗਾਵਨੑਿ. ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਨੑਿ; ਰਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ ਰਸਾਲੇ ॥
They alone sing of You, who are pleasing to Your will; Your devotees are imbued with Your sublime essence.
ਹੋਰਿ ਕੇਤੇ. ਤੁਧਨੋ ਗਾਵਨਿ, ਸੇ ਮੈ ਚਿਤਿ. ਨ ਆਵਨਿ; ਨਾਨਕੁ. ਕਿਆ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
So many others sing of You; they do not come to mind. O Nanak, how can I consider them all?
ਸੋਈ ਸੋਈ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ; ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਚੀ ਨਾਈ ॥
That Lord and Master is true, forever true; He is True, and True is His Name.
ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਸੀ. ਜਾਇ ਨ ਜਾਸੀ; ਰਚਨਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਚਾਈ ॥
He is, and shall always be; He shall not depart, even when this universe which He has created departs.
ਰੰਗੀ ਰੰਗੀ ਭਾਤੀ ਜਿਨਸੀ; ਮਾਇਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਉਪਾਈ ॥
He created the world, with its various colours, species of beings and the variety of Maya.
ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਕੀਤਾ ਅਪਣਾ; ਜਿਉ ਤਿਸ ਦੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Having created the creation, He watches over it Himself, as His greatness pleases.
ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਸੀ; ਫਿਰਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ. ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
He does whatever pleases Him; no order can be issued to Him.
348: ਸੋ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਸਾਹਾ ਪਤਿ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਰਹਣੁ ਰਜਾਈ ॥੧॥੧॥
He is the King, the King of kings, the Supreme Lord and Master of kings; O Nanak, remain subject to His will. ॥1॥1॥
ਸੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ. ਹਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ; ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮਾ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
That Primal Being is immaculate and pure; the Lord, the Primal Being, is immaculate and pure. The Lord is inaccessible, unreachable and unrivalled.
ਸਭਿ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ. ਸਭਿ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੀ; ਹਰਿ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
All meditate, all meditate on You, O Dear Lord, O True Creator Lord.
ਸਭਿ ਜੀਅ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ਜੀ; ਤੂੰ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾਰਾ ॥
All living beings are Yours; You are the Giver of all souls.
ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਜੀ; ਸਭਿ ਦੂਖ ਵਿਸਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
Meditate on the Lord, O saints; He is the Dispeller of all sorrow.
ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ. ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜੀ; ਕਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੰਤ ਵਿਚਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
The Lord Himself is the Master, the Lord Himself is the Servant; O Nanak, the poor beings are wretched and miserable! ॥1॥
ਤੂੰ ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ. ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਜੀ; ਹਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸਮਾਣਾ ॥
You are constant in each and every heart, and in all things; O Dear Lord, You are the One.
ਇਕਿ ਦਾਤੇ. ਇਕਿ ਭੇਖਾਰੀ ਜੀ; ਸਭਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਚੋਜ ਵਿਡਾਣਾ ॥
Some are givers, and some are beggars; this is all Your wondrous play.
ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਦਾਤਾ. ਆਪੇ ਭੁਗਤਾ ਜੀ; ਹਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ. ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
You Yourself are the Giver, and You Yourself are the Enjoyer; I know no other than You.
ਤੂੰ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ. ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਜੀ; ਤੇਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣਾ ॥
You are the Supreme Lord God, limitless and infinite; what virtues of Yours can I speak of and describe?
ਜੋ ਸੇਵਹਿ. ਜੋ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੀ; ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ. ਤਿਨੑ ਕੁਰਬਾਣਾ ॥੨॥
Unto those who serve You, unto those who serve You, Dear Lord, servant Nanak is a sacrifice. ॥2॥
ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ. ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੀ ਸੇ; ਜਨ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਸੁਖ ਵਾਸੀ ॥
Those who meditate on You, Lord, those who meditate on You — those humble beings dwell in peace in this world.
ਸੇ ਮੁਕਤੁ. ਸੇ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਭਏ; ਜਿਨੑ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਜੀਉ; ਤਿਨ ਟੂਟੀ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ ॥
They are liberated, they are liberated, those who meditate on the Lord; for them, the noose of death is cut away.
ਜਿਨ ਨਿਰਭਉ. ਜਿਨੑ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਜੀਉ; ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਸਭੁ ਗਵਾਸੀ ॥
Those who meditate on the Fearless One, on the Fearless Lord — all their fears are dispelled.
ਜਿਨੑ ਸੇਵਿਆ. ਜਿਨੑ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ; ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੂਪਿ ਸਮਾਸੀ ॥
Those who serve, those who serve my Dear Lord, are absorbed into the Being of the Lord, Har, Har.
ਸੇ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੇ ਧੰਨੁ. ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਜੀਉ; ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ. ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਸੀ ॥੩॥
Blessed are they, blessed are they, who meditate on their Dear Lord; servant Nanak is a sacrifice to them. ॥3॥
ਤੇਰੀ ਭਗਤਿ. ਤੇਰੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਜੀ; ਭਰੇ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਬੇਅੰਤਾ ॥
Devotion to You, devotion to You, is a treasure overflowing, infinite and beyond measure.
ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ. ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ ਸਲਾਹਨਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੀ; ਹਰਿ ਅਨਿਕ ਅਨੇਕ ਅਨੰਤਾ ॥
Your devotees, Your devotees, praise You, O Dear Lord, in so many various and countless ways.
ਤੇਰੀ ਅਨਿਕ. ਤੇਰੀ ਅਨਿਕ, ਕਰਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਪੂਜਾ ਜੀ; ਤਪੁ ਤਾਪਹਿ ਜਪਹਿ ਬੇਅੰਤਾ ॥
For You, so many, for You, so many perform worship services, O Dear Infinite Lord; they practise disciplined meditation and chant endlessly.
ਤੇਰੇ ਅਨੇਕ ਤੇਰੇ ਅਨੇਕ. ਪੜਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ ਜੀ; ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਿਆ ਖਟੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੰਤਾ ॥
For You, so many, for You, so many read the various Simritees and Shastras; they perform rituals and the six religious duties.
ਸੇ ਭਗਤ. ਸੇ ਭਗਤ ਭਲੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀ; ਜੋ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਵੰਤਾ ॥੪॥
Those devotees, those devotees are sublime, O servant Nanak, who are pleasing to my Lord God. ॥4॥
ਤੂੰ ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਜੀ; ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ. ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
You are the Primal Being, the most wonderful Creator; there is no other as great as You.
ਤੂੰ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਏਕੋ. ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਤੂੰ ਏਕੋ ਜੀ; ਤੂੰ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਸੋਈ ॥
Age after age, You are the One; forever and ever, You are the One, O Dear Lord; You are the eternal, unchanging Creator.
ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਭਾਵੈ. ਸੋਈ ਵਰਤੈ ਜੀ; ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
Whatever pleases You comes to pass; You Yourself accomplish whatever happens.
ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਭ ਉਪਾਈ ਜੀ; ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਸਿਰਜਿ ਸਭ ਗੋਈ ॥
You Yourself created the entire universe, and having fashioned it, You Yourself shall destroy it all.
ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ. ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਕਰਤੇ ਕੇ ਜੀ; ਜੋ ਸਭਸੈ ਕਾ ਜਾਣੋਈ ॥੫॥੨॥
Servant Nanak sings the glorious praises of the Creator, the Knower of all. ॥5॥2॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
Hearing of Him, everyone calls Him great,
but how great He is, only one who has seen Him can tell.
349: His worth cannot be estimated; He cannot be described.
Those who describe You, Lord, remain immersed and absorbed in You. ॥1॥
ਵਡੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ; ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰਾ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰਾ ॥
O my Great Lord and Master of unfathomable depth, You are the ocean of excellence.
ਕੋਈ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ; ਤੇਰਾ ਕੇਤਾ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਚੀਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
No one knows the extent or the vastness of Your expanse. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
All the intuitive ones met and practised intuitive meditation;
all the appraisers met and made the appraisal.
The spiritual teachers, the masters of meditation, and the teachers of teachers —
ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ; ਤੇਰੀ ਤਿਲੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੨॥
they cannot describe even an iota of Your greatness. ॥2॥
ਸਭਿ ਸਤ. ਸਭਿ ਤਪ; ਸਭਿ ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆ ॥
All truth, all austere discipline, all goodness,
all the great miraculous spiritual powers of the Siddhas —
ਤੁਧੁ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਿਧੀ; ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈਆ ॥
without You, no one has attained such powers.
They are received only by Your grace; no one can block them or stop their flow. ॥3॥
What can the poor helpless creature do?
Your praises are overflowing with Your treasures.
ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ; ਤਿਸੈ ਕਿਆ ਚਾਰਾ ॥
Those unto whom You give — how can they think of any other?
O Nanak, the True One embellishes and exalts. ॥4॥1॥
Chanting the Name, I live; forgetting it, I die.
It is so difficult to chant the True Name.
If someone feels hunger for the True Name,
that hunger shall consume his pain. ॥1॥
How can I ever forget Him, O my mother?
True is the Master, True is His Name. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Trying to describe even an iota of the greatness of the True Name,
people have grown weary, but they have not been able to evaluate it.
ਜੇ ਸਭਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਕੈ; ਆਖਣ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
Even if everyone were to gather together and speak of Him,
ਵਡਾ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ; ਘਾਟਿ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
He would not become any greater or any lesser. ॥2॥
ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਮਰੈ; ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
That Lord does not die; there is no reason to mourn.
He continues to give, and His provisions never run short.
This virtue is His alone; there is no other like Him.
ਨਾ ਕੋ ਹੋਆ; ਨਾ ਕੋ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
There never has been, and there never will be. ॥3॥
As great as You Yourself are, O Lord, so great are Your gifts.
ਜਿਨਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ; ਕੀਤੀ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
You are the One who created the day as well as the night.
Those who forget their Lord and Master are vile and despicable.
O Nanak, without the Name, they are wretched outcasts. ॥4॥2॥
ਜੇ ਦਰਿ ਮਾਂਗਤੁ ਕੂਕ ਕਰੇ; ਮਹਲੀ ਖਸਮੁ ਸੁਣੇ ॥
If a beggar cries out at the door, the Master hears it in His mansion.
ਭਾਵੈ ਧੀਰਕ, ਭਾਵੈ ਧਕੇ; ਏਕ. ਵਡਾਈ ਦੇਇ ॥੧॥
Whether He receives him or pushes him away, it is the gift of the Lord's greatness. ॥1॥
ਜਾਣਹੁ ਜੋਤਿ. ਨ ਪੂਛਹੁ ਜਾਤੀ; ਆਗੈ. ਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਹੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Recognise the Lord's light within all, and do not consider social class or status; there are no classes or castes in the world hereafter. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
He Himself acts, and He Himself inspires us to act.
He Himself takes our complaints to heart.
Since You, O Creator Lord, are the Doer,
why should I submit to the world? ॥2॥
You Yourself created it, and You Yourself give to it.
You Yourself rid it of evil-mindedness.
By the Guru's grace, You come to dwell in our minds,
and then, pain and darkness are dispelled from within. ॥3॥
He Himself infuses love for the Truth.
Unto others, He does not give the Truth.
ਜੇ ਕਿਸੈ ਦੇਇ, ਵਖਾਣੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ; ਆਗੈ. ਪੂਛ ਨ ਲੇਇ ॥੪॥੩॥
If He gives it to someone, says Nanak, then that person is not called to account hereafter. ॥4॥3॥
The mind's restless thoughts are the cymbals and the ankle-bells;
the world is the drum beating in rhythm.
The mind dances like Naarad, to the tune of the Dark Age of Kali Yuga;
where can the celibates and the men of truth place their feet? ॥1॥
Nanak is a sacrifice to the Name of the Lord.
The world is blind; our Lord and Master is all-seeing. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The disciple feeds off the Guru;
out of love of bread, he comes to dwell in his home.
350: Even if one were to live and eat for a hundred years,
only that day is approved when one recognises one's Lord and Master. ॥2॥
Beholding one another, people feel no compassion.
ਲਏ ਦਿਤੇ ਵਿਣੁ; ਰਹੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
No one lives without giving or taking bribes.
The king dispenses justice only if his palm is filled.
No one is moved by an appeal in the Name of God. ॥3॥
O Nanak, they are human beings in form and name only;
by their deeds they are dogs — this is the command of the Lord's Court.
By the Guru's grace, if one sees himself as a guest in this world,
then he gains some honour in the Court of the Lord. ॥4॥4॥
ਜੇਤਾ ਸਬਦੁ. ਸੁਰਤਿ ਧੁਨਿ ਤੇਤੀ; ਜੇਤਾ ਰੂਪੁ ਕਾਇਆ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
As much as is the Word, so much is the sound-current of Your consciousness; as much as is the form of the universe, so much is Your body, Lord.
ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਰਸਨਾ. ਆਪੇ ਬਸਨਾ; ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਕਹਉ ਮਾਈ ॥੧॥
You Yourself are the tongue, and You Yourself are the life; there is no other at all, O mother, of whom I could speak. ॥1॥
My Lord and Master is One.
ਏਕੋ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ; ਏਕੋ ਹੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
He is the One, O brother; He is the One alone. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਆਪੇ ਮਾਰੇ ਆਪੇ ਛੋਡੈ; ਆਪੇ ਲੇਵੈ ਦੇਇ ॥
He kills and He saves; He takes and He gives.
ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ. ਆਪੇ ਵਿਗਸੈ; ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੨॥
He beholds, and He is pleased; He casts His glance of grace. ॥2॥
ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣਾ. ਸੋ ਕਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ; ਅਵਰੁ. ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
Whatever He is to do, He is doing; no one else can do anything.
ਜੈਸਾ ਵਰਤੈ. ਤੈਸੋ ਕਹੀਐ; ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੩॥
As He acts, so is He described; all this is Your glory, Lord. ॥3॥
ਕਲਿ ਕਲਵਾਲੀ, ਮਾਇਆ ਮਦੁ ਮੀਠਾ; ਮਨੁ ਮਤਵਾਲਾ, ਪੀਵਤੁ ਰਹੈ ॥
The Dark Age of Kali Yuga is the tavern, and Maya is the sweet wine; the intoxicated mind keeps on drinking it.
ਆਪੇ ਰੂਪ ਕਰੇ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਂਤੀਂ; ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬਪੁੜਾ. ਏਵ ਕਹੈ ॥੪॥੫॥
He Himself assumes all sorts of forms; thus speaks poor Nanak. ॥4॥5॥
Make your intellect your instrument, and love your tambourine;
thus bliss and lasting joy shall be produced in your mind.
This is devotional worship, and this is the practice of penance.
ਇਤੁ ਰੰਗਿ ਨਾਚਹੁ; ਰਖਿ ਰਖਿ ਪਾਉ ॥੧॥
So dance in this love, and keep the beat with your feet. ॥1॥
One who knows the praise of the Lord keeps the perfect beat;
ਹੋਰੁ ਨਚਣਾ; ਖੁਸੀਆ ਮਨ ਮਾਹ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
other dancing produces only pleasure in the mind. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Make truth and contentment your two cymbals.
Let your ankle bells be the lasting vision of the Lord.
Let your harmony and music be the elimination of duality.
ਇਤੁ ਰੰਗਿ ਨਾਚਹੁ; ਰਖਿ ਰਖਿ ਪਾਉ ॥੨॥
So dance in this love, and keep the beat with your feet. ॥2॥
Let the fear of God within your heart and mind be your spinning dance,
and keep up, whether sitting or standing.
To roll around in the dust is to know that the body is only ashes.
ਇਤੁ ਰੰਗਿ ਨਾਚਹੁ; ਰਖਿ ਰਖਿ ਪਾਉ ॥੩॥
So dance in this love, and keep the beat with your feet. ॥3॥
Keep the company of the disciples, the students who love the teachings.
As Gurmukh, listen to the True Name.
O Nanak, chant it, over and over again.
ਇਤੁ ਰੰਗਿ ਨਾਚਹੁ; ਰਖਿ ਰਖਿ ਪੈਰ ॥੪॥੬॥
So dance in this love, and keep the beat with your feet. ॥4॥6॥
ਪਉਣੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਧਰੀ ਸਭ ਧਰਤੀ; ਜਲ ਅਗਨੀ ਕਾ ਬੰਧੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
He created the air, and supports the whole earth; He bound water and fire together.
ਅੰਧੁਲੈ ਦਹਸਿਰਿ ਮੂੰਡੁ ਕਟਾਇਆ; ਰਾਵਣੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਿਆ ਵਡਾ ਭਇਆ ॥੧॥
The blind ten-headed Raawan had his heads cut off, but what greatness was obtained by killing him? ॥1॥
What praises of Yours can be chanted?
ਤੂੰ ਸਰਬੇ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ; ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
You are all-pervading, lovingly attuned to all. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜੀਅ ਉਪਾਇ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਹਥਿ ਕੀਨੀ; ਕਾਲੀ ਨਥਿ ਕਿਆ ਵਡਾ ਭਇਆ ॥
You created all beings, and You hold their ways in Your hands; what greatness is it that You subdued the black serpent Kaali?
ਕਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਪੁਰਖੁ. ਜੋਰੂ ਕਉਣ ਕਹੀਐ; ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥੨॥
Whose Husband are You? Who is Your wife? You are pervading, through and through, in all. ॥2॥
ਨਾਲਿ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਸਾਥਿ ਵਰਦਾਤਾ; ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਭਾਲਣ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
Brahma, the giver of boons, born of the lotus stem with his family, went into the stem to find the extent of the universe.
ਆਗੈ. ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ, ਤਾ ਕਾ; ਕੰਸੁ ਛੇਦਿ. ਕਿਆ ਵਡਾ ਭਇਆ ॥੩॥
Proceeding, he could not find its limits; what glory is obtained by killing the demon Kansa? ॥3॥
ਰਤਨ ਉਪਾਇ ਧਰੇ, ਖੀਰੁ ਮਥਿਆ; ਹੋਰਿ ਭਖਲਾਏ, ਜਿ ਅਸੀ ਕੀਆ ॥
The jewels were produced and brought forth by churning the ocean of milk; the others angrily cried out, "We did this!"
